scientific_integrity: All finite-sample formulas analytically derived; executable rational checks are supplementary; historical overlap searched without a global uniqueness claim.
scientific_limitations: Historical priority remains uncertain, especially Pettitt 1979 and Anderson 1962 full text. Only continuous common-distribution null and explicitly normalized rank statistics are covered; no combined-test tail or power theorem.
title: Exact finite-sample dependence of squared Wilcoxon and Cramér–von Mises statistics
